headword: {過剰摂取|かじょうせっしゅ}

definitions.explanation: Consuming more of something (food, nutrients, medication, etc.) than is recommended or healthy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{塩分|えんぶん}→塩分：09945_enbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{過剰摂取|かじょうせっしゅ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To be careful about excessive salt intake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{糖分|とうぶん}→糖分：15847_toubun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{過剰摂取|かじょうせっしゅ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{肥満|ひまん}→肥満：13920_himan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Excessive sugar intake leads to obesity.

examples.japanese: ⟦サプリメント→サプリメント：10937_sapurimento⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{過剰摂取|かじょうせっしゅ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{害|がい}→害：02542_gai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{及|およ}ぼす→及ぼす：02028_oyobosu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Excessive intake of supplements can harm your health.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{過剰|かじょう}→過剰：04123_kajou⟧ (excessive, surplus) and ⟦{摂取|せっしゅ}→摂取：09322_sesshu⟧ (intake, ingestion). Commonly used in health, nutrition, and medical contexts. Can refer to food, nutrients, medication, or substances.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{塩分|えんぶん}→塩分：09945_enbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{過剰摂取|かじょうせっしゅ}: excessive salt intake
- ⟦{糖分|とうぶん}→糖分：15847_toubun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{過剰摂取|かじょうせっしゅ}: excessive sugar intake
- ⟦カロリー→カロリー：06109_karorii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{過剰摂取|かじょうせっしゅ}: excessive calorie intake
- ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{過剰摂取|かじょうせっしゅ}: drug overdose

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{摂取|せっしゅ}→摂取：09322_sesshu⟧: intake, ingestion — the neutral base word
- ⟦{過剰|かじょう}→過剰：04123_kajou⟧: excessive, surplus — also used in {過剰反応|かじょうはんのう} (overreaction)
- {過量投与|かりょうとうよ}: overdosage — a medical term for administering too much medication
